test_std_exception: test throwing a standard C++ std::exception and catching it as a Python RuntimeError
test_error_already_set: test pybind11's error_already_set mechanism for propagating pre-set Python exceptions from C++
test_cross_module_exceptions: test cross-module exception propagation between separate pybind11 extension modules
test_custom: test custom C++ exception types, exception translation, rethrowing, and exception subclassing in pybind11
test_nested_throws: test nested C++ to Python to C++ exception handling chains with try_catch
